services.desc: Surfing an uncrowded point break in a tropical location has to be one of the best feelings in the world. Now, imagine pulling up to empty waves on a private luxury yacht with your closest friends. Epic Pacific Charters now offers all inclusive Surf & Fish charters in Cabo San Lucas, Puerto Vallarta, Punta de Mita & Sayulita, Mexico. Punta Mita and Sayulita are home to some of the most incredible waves in Mexico. This area is also known for it's amazing saltwater fishing for giant Yellowfin Tuna, Marlin, Dorado, Roosterfish & much more! Spend a few days surfing and fishing on board one of our luxury yachts.
